title: Example 1: Differential expression with runscMI()
text: example runs complete scMetaIntegrator (scMI) analysis public dataset returns table differentially expressed genes (DEGs). uses runscMI(), simplest entry point. runscMI() returns one row per gene pooled effect size significance. Example 2 shows get full MetaIntegrator object forest plots gene scores. scMI designed paired designs, donor measured two conditions. donor analyzed study, results pooled across donors random-effects meta-analysis. keeps donor unit replication avoids treating cells one donor independent replicates. workflow four steps:

title: Example 1: Differential expression with runscMI()
text: example data come ifnb.SeuratData package. Install . Loading MetaIntegrator required run scMetaIntegrator. ggplot2 ggrepel used plots end.
code: install.packages("https://seurat.nygenome.org/src/contrib/ifnb.SeuratData_3.0.0.tar.gz",                  repos = NULL, type = "source") library(scMetaIntegrator) library(Seurat) library(ifnb.SeuratData) library(MetaIntegrator) library(multtest)  ## packages for the plots in step 5 library(ggplot2) library(ggrepel) theme_set(theme_bw())

what: Step 1: Load and preprocess the data
title: Example 1: Differential expression with runscMI()
text: ifnb dataset contains PBMCs either stimulated interferon beta (STIM) left controls (CTRL). dataset record donors, assign cell one three pseudo donors. gives us pairing variable demonstration. data, use real donor patient ID. scMI needs three metadata columns: scMI also needs log-normalized expression data layer, NormalizeData() creates.
code: data("ifnb") ifnb = UpdateSeuratObject(ifnb) ifnb = NormalizeData(ifnb)  ## assign cells to three pseudo donors in turn, then build a unique sample ID ifnb$pseudoDonor = paste0("pseudoDonor_", rep(1:3, length.out = ncol(ifnb))) ifnb$sample      = paste0(ifnb$pseudoDonor, "_", ifnb$stim)  table(ifnb$pseudoDonor, ifnb$stim) #>                 #>                 CTRL STIM #>   pseudoDonor_1 2183 2484 #>   pseudoDonor_2 2183 2483 #>   pseudoDonor_3 2182 2484

title: Example 1: Differential expression with runscMI()
text: confirmPairs() returns TRUE every pair exactly two samples, one per condition. returns FALSE, use completePairSubset() keep complete pairs, set completePairsOnly = TRUE runscMI().
code: confirmPairs(ifnb, uniqueSampleID = "sample", pairingColumn = "pseudoDonor") #> [1] TRUE

title: Example 1: Differential expression with runscMI()
text: Genes barely detected add noise extra tests. thresholdGenesAcrossPairs() keeps genes detected least 1% cells every pair. Passing result runscMI() restricts analysis genes.
code: thresholdedGenes = thresholdGenesAcrossPairs(   seuratObject     = ifnb,   uniqueSampleID   = "sample",   pairingColumn    = "pseudoDonor",   percentThreshold = 0.01 ) length(thresholdedGenes) #> [1] 7043

title: Example 1: Differential expression with runscMI()
text: groupOne condition whose effect want estimate, groupTwo reference, usually control. positive effect size means higher expression groupOne.  output one row per gene columns:
code: scMI_output = runscMI(   seuratObject          = ifnb,   uniqueSampleID        = "sample",   pairingColumn         = "pseudoDonor",   comparisonGroupColumn = "stim",   groupOne              = "STIM",   groupTwo              = "CTRL",   thresholdGenes        = thresholdedGenes ) #> Generating full MA object #> Running meta-analysis #> Found common probes in 2  #> Found common probes in 3  #> Computing effect sizes... #> Computing summary effect sizes... #> Computing Fisher's output... head(scMI_output[order(scMI_output$effectSizeFDR), ]) #>              gene effectSize effectSizeFDR effectSizePval effectSizeBF numPairs #> APOBEC3A APOBEC3A  0.9110546             0              0            0        3 #> B2M           B2M  1.0527816             0              0            0        3 #> BST2         BST2  1.0760492             0              0            0        3 #> CCL8         CCL8  0.9505989             0              0            0        3 #> CD14         CD14 -0.7080852             0              0            0        3 #> CD38         CD38  0.7017553             0              0            0        3

text: volcano plot shows pooled effect size significance gene. Genes FDR 0.05 absolute effect size 0.5 colored. label five genes largest effect size direction. FDR values 0 set 1e-300 can plotted log scale.
code: volcano_df = scMI_output volcano_df$neg_log10_fdr = -log10(pmax(volcano_df$effectSizeFDR, 1e-300)) volcano_df$category = ifelse(volcano_df$effectSizeFDR < 0.05 & volcano_df$effectSize >  0.5, "Up in STIM",                       ifelse(volcano_df$effectSizeFDR < 0.05 & volcano_df$effectSize < -0.5, "Up in CTRL",                              "Not significant")) volcano_df$category = factor(volcano_df$category,                              levels = c("Up in STIM", "Up in CTRL", "Not significant"))  ## label the top 5 genes by effect size in each direction sig_df    = volcano_df[volcano_df$category != "Not significant", ] label_df  = rbind(head(sig_df[order(-sig_df$effectSize), ], 5),                   head(sig_df[order( sig_df$effectSize), ], 5))  ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = effectSize, y = neg_log10_fdr, color = category)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +   geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +   geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +   geom_text_repel(data = label_df, aes(label = gene),                            color = "black", size = 3.5, max.overlaps = Inf,                            box.padding = 0.5, segment.color = "grey60") +   scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in STIM"      = "#A40000FF",                                 "Up in CTRL"      = "#16317DFF",                                 "Not significant" = "grey70")) +   labs(x = "Pooled effect size (Hedges' g)",        y = expression(-log[10](FDR)),        color = NULL) +   theme(legend.position = "top")

title: Getting started with scMetaIntegrator
text: scMetaIntegrator (scMI) tests differential expression paired single-cell RNA-seq data. matched pair, one donor measured two conditions, treated one study. Within pair, scMI compares cells two conditions computes per-gene effect size (Hedges’ g). pools effect sizes across pairs random-effects meta-analysis using MetaIntegrator. article walks complete analysis simulated data, checking pairing plotting results. Loading MetaIntegrator package required run scMetaIntegrator.
code: library(scMetaIntegrator) library(Seurat) library(MetaIntegrator) library(ggplot2) library(ggrepel)  theme_set(theme_bw())

title: Getting started with scMetaIntegrator
text: scMI needs Seurat v5 object log-normalized expression data layer three metadata columns. Every pair must contain exactly two samples, one per condition.

title: Getting started with scMetaIntegrator
text: simulate four donors, sampled control stimulated condition, 80 cells per sample. Three genes (GENE1 GENE3) -regulated stimulated condition.
code: set.seed(4) n_genes   = 300 genes     = paste0("GENE", seq_len(n_genes)) donors    = paste0("donor", 1:4) conds     = c("CTRL", "STIM") n_cells   = 80 de_genes  = c("GENE1", "GENE2", "GENE3") base_mean = rgamma(n_genes, shape = 1, rate = 1) names(base_mean) = genes  counts_list = list() meta_list   = list() for (d in donors) {   for (cnd in conds) {     mu = base_mean     if (cnd == "STIM") mu[de_genes] = mu[de_genes] * 3     size_factor = rlnorm(n_cells, 0, 0.2)     m = sapply(size_factor, function(sf) rnbinom(n_genes, mu = mu * sf, size = 2))     sample_id = paste(d, cnd, sep = "_")     cell_ids  = paste(sample_id, seq_len(n_cells), sep = "_")     dimnames(m) = list(genes, cell_ids)     counts_list[[sample_id]] = m     meta_list[[sample_id]] = data.frame(sample    = rep(sample_id, n_cells),                                         donor     = rep(d, n_cells),                                         condition = rep(cnd, n_cells),                                         row.names = cell_ids)   } }  seu = CreateSeuratObject(counts = do.call(cbind, counts_list),                          meta.data = do.call(rbind, meta_list)) seu = NormalizeData(seu) table(seu$donor, seu$condition) #>          #>          CTRL STIM #>   donor1   80   80 #>   donor2   80   80 #>   donor3   80   80 #>   donor4   80   80

title: scMetaIntegrator: a meta-analysis approach to paired single-cell differential expression analysis
text: single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) studies become increasingly complex, traditional differential gene expression methods can fall short, particularly paired repeated measures matched cohort designs. Many existing approaches consider cells independent samples, leading false positives ignoring inherent sampling structures. pseudobulk methods can address , ignore intra-sample gene expression variability, resulting high false negatives. propose novel meta-analysis approach accounts biological replicates cell variability paired scRNA-seq data. method, single-cell MetaIntegrator, yields robust effect size estimates reproducible p-values, demonstrating effectiveness real synthetic datasets. also builds established MetaIntegrator package suite visualization analysis techniques.
